name: card_frame_training
desc: pixel art trading card frame for a gym bodybuilding card game. Dark charcoal body, red metallic beveled border with small metal rivets at the corners. Each piece is an empty recessed area: illustration window is plain dark, effect text box is plain cream paper, body part row and weight panel are plain dark grey insets. No text, no icons, flat empty areas.
